name_zh: 普利瓦（卢蒙巴）：从殖民地职员到民族解放的『主权回归法』与反帝斗争治理范式
name_en: Lumumba (Patrice): From Colonial Clerk to National Liberation — the 'Sovereignty Return' and Anti-Imperial Struggle Governance Paradigm
description_zh: 帕特里斯·卢蒙巴（Patrice Émery Lumumba，1925-1961），中文常译作'卢蒙巴'（任务中称'普利瓦'）——刚果民主共和国首任总理（1960年），非洲民族解放运动最激进的革命领袖之一。他出身刚果南部 Kasai 地区普通农民家庭，20世纪40年代在比利时殖民官僚体系中从邮局职员起步，通过自学掌握了法语和荷兰语，成为殖民地少数具备行政能力的非洲精英。卢蒙巴的核心思维贡献在于将'民族解放（national liberation）'从殖民者的恩赐叙事升维为可操作的'主权回归法'——通过'民族运动党（MNC）建立→1958年布鲁塞尔泛非会议→独立谈判→反帝斗争'四阶段路径，在比利时殖民统治的最后时刻完成了刚果政治自主的制度设计。他的'主权回归法（Sovereignty Return）'强调：真正的独立不是殖民者主动让渡权力，而是被殖民地人民以'不可逆的政治行动'迫使宗主国交出主权。卢蒙巴是Protreptic中模式34（战略预判法）在'后殖民主权重构'场景的唯一中部非洲样本，也是模式19（非暴力抵抗法）在'反帝斗争政治动员'场景的独特代表。他的遇刺（1961年，比利时特工与刚果分裂势力合谋）成为非洲去殖民化史上最血腥的转折点。
description_en: Patrice Émery Lumumba (1925-1961), commonly translated as 'Lumumba' in Chinese (referred to as '普利瓦' in this task) — first Prime Minister of the Democratic Republic of Congo (1960), one of Africa's most radical revolutionary leaders in nationalist liberation movements. Born to an ordinary farming family in Kasai region, southern Congo, he started as a post office clerk within the Belgian colonial bureaucracy in the 1940s, self-taught French and Dutch, becoming one of the few Africans with administrative capability in the colony. Lumumba's core thinking contribution was elevating 'national liberation' from colonial gift narrative to an operable 'Sovereignty Return method' — through a four-stage path ('MNC establishment→1958 Brussels Pan-African Conference→independence negotiation→anti-imperial struggle'), he completed Congo's political autonomy institutional design at the final moment of Belgian colonial rule. His 'Sovereignty Return' emphasizes: true independence is not power voluntarily ceded by colonizers, but sovereignty forced from the colonial power through 'irreversible political action' by the colonized people. Lumumba is the sole Central African sample of mode 34 (Strategic Prediction) in 'post-colonial sovereignty reconstruction' scenarios, and the unique representative of mode 19 (Nonviolent Resistance) in 'anti-imperial political mobilization' scenarios. His assassination (1961, conspiracy between Belgian agents and Congolese separatists) became the bloodiest turning point in African decolonization history.
reason_zh: 卢蒙巴填补了Protreptic在'反帝斗争主权重构路径'领域中部非洲空白。他是模式34（战略预判法）在刚果去殖民化场景的唯一样本，展示了如何将'殖民地官僚体系内的有限知识'转化为'不可逆的政治自主行动'；也是模式19（非暴力抵抗法）在'反帝斗争政治动员'场景的全球标杆。他的主权回归理论对理解后殖民时代帝国主义的运作机制、非洲解放运动的政治策略具有不可替代的研究价值，也为当代反新殖民主义斗争提供了经典案例。
reason_en: Lumumba fills Protreptic's Central African gap in 'anti-imperial struggle sovereignty reconstruction path'. He is the sole sample of mode 34 (Strategic Prediction) in Congo decolonization scenarios, demonstrating how to transform 'limited knowledge within colonial bureaucracy' into 'irreversible political autonomy action'; also the global benchmark of mode 19 (Nonviolent Resistance) in 'anti-imperial political mobilization' scenarios. His sovereignty return theory has irreplaceable research value for understanding imperialism's operation mechanisms in the post-colonial era, African liberation movement political strategies, providing a classic case for contemporary anti-neocolonial struggles.
steps_zh: 第1步（模式34战略预判法）：政治觉醒与组织构建——在比利时殖民官僚体系中从邮局职员（1947年）起步，自学法语和荷兰语，识别'殖民者对殖民地行政的依赖'这一结构性矛盾，1956年起秘密建立民族运动党（MNC）
第2步（模式19非暴力抵抗法）：布鲁塞尔宣言——1958年代表刚果参加加纳阿克拉泛非会议，在会议上发表'刚果人民不可能继续接受一个剥夺他们尊严、自由和主权的政权'宣言，标志着刚果独立运动的公开化
第3步（模式6统一战线法）：独立谈判博弈——在1960年比利时-刚果圆桌会议上，拒绝接受殖民者设定的'渐进独立'框架，要求立即完全主权移交；在仅6周选举后迅速组建联合政府，成为独立后的首任总理
第4步（模式31框架效应法）：反帝主权重构——独立后面对加丹加省分裂（比利时支持）、联合国维和部队介入、美国中情局颠覆，发表'刚果独立宣言'（1960年6月30日），直接挑战比利时国王博杜安'你们终于获得了自由'的殖民叙事
第5步（范式固化）：主权回归法——将'政治觉醒→公开宣言→独立博弈→反帝重构'四环沉淀为后殖民时代非洲主权斗争的可操作模板
steps_en: Step 1 (Mode 34 Strategic Prediction): Political awakening and organization — starting as post office clerk in Belgian colonial bureaucracy (1947), self-taught French and Dutch, identifying the structural contradiction of 'colonizers' dependence on colonial administration', secretly establishing Mouvement National Congolais (MNC) from 1956

Step 2 (Mode 19 Nonviolent Resistance): Brussels Declaration — representing Congo at Ghana Accra Pan-African Conference in 1958, delivering the declaration 'the Congolese people cannot continue to accept a regime that strips them of their dignity, freedom and sovereignty', marking the public emergence of Congo's independence movement

Step 3 (Mode 6 United Front): Independence negotiation — at the 1960 Belgium-Congo roundtable conference, refusing colonialists' 'gradual independence' framework, demanding immediate complete sovereignty transfer; rapidly forming coalition government after just 6 weeks of elections, becoming first Prime Minister

Step 4 (Mode 31 Framing Effect): Anti-imperial sovereignty reconstruction — facing Katanga secession (Belgian-backed), UN peacekeeping intervention, CIA subversion after independence, delivering 'Congo Independence Declaration' (June 30, 1960), directly challenging Belgian King Baudouin's 'you have finally gained freedom' colonial narrative

Step 5 (Paradigm Solidification): Sovereignty return method — condensing 'political awakening→public declaration→independence negotiation→anti-imperial reconstruction' into an operable template for post-colonial African sovereignty struggle
expected_zh: 掌握卢蒙巴从殖民地职员到民族解放领袖的政治觉醒路径；理解'主权回归法'如何在比利时殖民统治的最后时刻操作化刚果独立；评估卢蒙巴遇刺对非洲去殖民化进程的持续影响。
expected_en: Master Lumumba's political awakening path from colonial clerk to national liberation leader; understand how 'Sovereignty Return' operationalized Congo's independence at the final moment of Belgian colonial rule; evaluate the continuing impact of Lumumba's assassination on African decolonization process.
case_zh: 1960年6月30日，刚果独立典礼上，比利时国王博杜安发表殖民颂扬演讲后，29岁的卢蒙巴在未获邀请的情况下突然走向讲台，发表了震撼世界的'刚果独立宣言'：'没有殖民统治下的苦难，就不会有今天的独立；今天我们看到的不是恩赐而是斗争的结果……刚果人民用鲜血赢得了他们的尊严。'随后他面对加丹加省矿主莫伊斯·冲伯的分裂（比利时军队支持）、联合国秘书长哈马舍尔德的'维和'介入、美国中情局的颠覆行动，坚持刚果完整主权。1960年9月被总统卡萨武布解职，随后被军队囚禁并秘密转移到加丹加。1961年1月17日，卢蒙巴在比利时特工监视下被枪杀。联合国2001年报告承认比利时对卢蒙巴之死负有'道德责任'。他的遗言'你们以为会埋葬我，但种子已经播下'成为非洲反帝斗争的不朽象征。
case_en: On June 30, 1960, during Congo's independence ceremony, after Belgian King Baudouin delivered his colonial praising speech, the 29-year-old Lumumba, uninvited to the podium, delivered a world-shaking 'Congo Independence Declaration': 'Without the suffering under colonial rule there would be no independence today; what we see is not a gift but the result of struggle... The Congolese people won their dignity with blood.' He then faced Katanga secessionist Moïse Tshombe (Belgian army-backed), UN Secretary-General Hammarskjöld's 'peacekeeping' intervention, and CIA subversion operations, insisting on Congo's complete sovereignty. Dismissed by President Kasa-Vubu in September 1960, then imprisoned by the army and secretly transferred to Katanga. On January 17, 1961, Lumumba was executed under Belgian agent surveillance. A UN 2001 report acknowledged Belgium bore 'moral responsibility' for Lumumba's death. His last words: 'You think you will bury me, but the seeds have been sown' became an immortal symbol of African anti-imperial struggle.
